posts.title: EsoNatLangs Bring the Complexity of Natural Language into Code
posts.description: The five esolangs discussed in this piece -- Coem, Love Languages, Prāsa, Kip, and Captive -- draw on aspects of natural language usually avoided in code: nuance and ambiguity, complex grammars and morphologies. They stand apart from the better‑known, jokier esolangs like LOLCODE or RockStar, which borrow from natlangs only for their vocabulary, building lexicons of memespeak or power-ballad lyric

posts.title: Forty-Four Esolangs: an artist's monograph of programming languages
posts.description: I have two pieces of esolang news: one personal, the other about this blog. First, a collection of my esolang work is now out with MIT Press. A sampling of the languages are posted on my site , but that list leans toward the implemented, which excludes some of the more poetic, less implementable langs.
